operation: GitHub contents update without explicit branch parameter
impact: Main branch ref was temporarily moved by one unintended metadata-only commit and then restored to the exact pre-incident SHA. The commit object remains retrievable by SHA but is not on main. RC11 changes were separately written to the intended isolated branch.
prevention: Always pass explicit branch on every GitHub create/update/delete operation; after each write verify target branch and main ref; use expected SHA compare-and-swap; add preflight wrapper or tool argument check.
release_effect: No certification. Incident is disclosed and preserved; independent repository audit should confirm ref history and no downstream consumer observed the transient head.
